title: Rapid Cycle Temperature Swing Adsorption Using Cal
one_line_summary: CALF-20 shows thermal_stability_temperature = 300.0 K for O2/H2O

key_insights.title: Mechanism
key_insights.body: superior oxygen and steam stability with NOX/SOX tolerance → stability

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] optimize the MOF adsorbent material, contactor, and process cycle to minimize steam ratio → target steam ratio below 1.3

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: commercially produced BASF adsorbent beds vs lab-scale adsorbent beds: winner=tie on overall performance

notable_quotes: The process still required optimization to lower steam ratio, with a stated target of reducing it below 1.3.
In Phase 2 steady state operation at 16–19% flue-gas CO2, CALF-20 delivered 10.6 TPD/m3 productivity and 97 ± 2% CO2 purity.
About 900 hours of field testing in a real cement kiln flue gas application achieved target performance metrics with stable operation.
